I prefer keeping Edit and Delete in the “More” menu, especially since additional actions will be added. The read-later action deserves to remain visible because it’s used more frequently.

A single clear confirmation is enough for permanent deletion, provided it is easy to cancel and archive remains the safer reversible choice. Preventing an edited address from colliding with another saved bookmark is also the right behaviour.

Making the whole card open the original page feels natural and gives it a generous click target. Tags and controls continuing to perform their own actions avoids ambiguity. This management flow works for me; let’s move on to archive versus delete.
